title: Dark Chocolate Mousse
summary: A classic French mousse with a rich, bittersweet chocolate flavour and a light, airy texture. It’s an elegant make-ahead dessert for dinner parties or a simple indulgent finish to a meal.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate gently in a heatproof bowl over a pan of just-simmering water, or in short bursts in the microwave, then let it cool for 5 minutes so it is warm but not hot.
Whisk the egg yolks with the vanilla extract until smooth, then stir them into the melted chocolate until fully combined.
In a clean bowl, whip the double cream to soft peaks; it should hold its shape but still look billowy.
In another clean bowl, whisk the egg whites with the pinch of salt until foamy, then gradually add the sugar and whisk to glossy stiff peaks.
Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture, then gently fold in the egg whites in two additions, keeping as much air in the mixture as possible.
Spoon the mousse into 4 glasses or ramekins and chill for at least 2 hours, until set and airy.
Serve cold, optionally with a few chocolate shavings or fresh berries if desired.
